Subject: VPC/on-prem governance gateway validation & rollback simulation

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the runbook draft. Before we sign off on the Private deployment cutover window next week, CentraBank needs to validate the governance gateway rules and run a short rollback simulation to prove our escape hatch works cleanly. Key asks from our side: 

- Confirm the exact egress/ingress ACLs the Redwood appliance will create when the VPC tunnel is established (we need a diff against our baseline rules).
- Walk through the CRIT path for KV-cache warmup and how the gateway handles prefix cache invalidation on rollback.
- Execute a 30-minute rollback simulation inside a maintenance window to validate route convergence and fallback provisioning.
- Provide a minimal evidence bundle (logs, traceroutes, firewall rule dumps) for our audit team.

Attached: network-topology-v2.pdf (annotated), evidence_requirements.xlsx (audit matrix).

We'd like to schedule the validation + rollback sim for Wed Nov 3 09:00-10:30 PT. Can Redwood ops/infra join? Please confirm owners and prework checklist items so we can run this as a tight rehearsal.

Appreciate it — Tom

--
Tom Benson

Folks — quick technical checklist and what's staged on our side: 

- BGP/Peering: We will announce only the agreed prefix block (10.240.32.0/20) during the canary. Route-maps staged. We will capture pre/post RIB dumps and provide them to CentraBank (routing_dump_before.txt, routing_dump_after.txt).
- ACL diff: I'll export the existing baseline ACL and the proposed gateway ACL and place diffs in the Drive folder (acl_diff_20271102.txt). CentraBank: please provide your baseline ACL export by Tue EOD.
- KV-cache purge: rollback-playbook.md (attached) includes a controlled KV purge sequence: 1) quiesce new traffic, 2) withdraw announcement, 3) kick cache purge job, 4) verify warmed nodes fall back to on-disk store. Time budget: 18 minutes worst-case for cache rehydration.
- NAT/timeouts: Ensure your firewall allows TCP keepalive 60s and UDP 30s for streaming. We will not change nat rules outside the maintenance window.

Artifacts I'll produce on the sim: route_convergence.log, traceroute_samples.txt, firewall_dump_post.txt, kvcache_metrics_post.csv.

If CentraBank wants, we can run a dry-run tomorrow (Tue) limited to a single test subnet to validate ACL diffs before the full-window sim. Recommend doing that if the audit team needs an intermediate proof point.

Prioym
Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
